Aew Capital Management LP Decreased Its Public Storage (PSA) Holding by $7.98 Million as Valuation Rose; Castleark Management Increased Plains All Amern Pipeline L (PAA) Holding
June 22, 2018 - By Vivian Currie
Jeffrey Furber decreased its stake in Public Storage (PSA) by 5.03% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Aew Capital Management LP sold 39,900 shares as the company’s stock rose 6.44% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Jeffrey Furber held 753,049 shares of the real estate investment trusts company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $150.90 million, down from 792,949 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Aew Capital Management LP who had been investing in Public Storage for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $38.70 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.51% or $3.31 during the last trading session, reaching $221.84. About 1.00M shares traded or 23.63% up from the average. Public Storage (NYSE:PSA) has declined 3.96% since June 22, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 16.53% the S&P500. Castleark Management Llc increased its stake in Plains All Amern Pipeline L (PAA) by 166.09% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 376,330 shares of the energy company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $8.29M, up from 141,430 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Castleark Management Llc who had been investing in Plains All Amern Pipeline L for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $17.54 billion market cap company. Aew Capital Management L P, which manages about $25.93B and $3.56 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Federal Realty Invs Trust (NYSE:FRT) by 5,750 shares to 761,009 shares, valued at $88.36 million in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Tanger Factory Outlet Centers Inc (NYSE:SKT) by 142,500 shares in the quarter, for a total of 1.73M shares, and has risen its stake in Host Hotels & Resorts Inc (NYSE:HST).

Analysts await Public Storage (NYSE:PSA) to report earnings on July, 25. They expect $2.60 EPS, up 12.55% or $0.29 from last year’s $2.31 per share. PSA’s profit will be $453.59 million for 21.33 P/E if the $2.60 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.48 actual EPS reported by Public Storage for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 4.84% EPS growth.
